summary: Install ansible-dev-tools on registered RHEL 8+ with Podman or Docker: check SCA with subscription-manager status, attach the AAP pool if needed, then dnf install --enablerepo=ansible-automation-platform-2.6-for-rhel-<8|9|10>-x86_64-rpms ansible-dev-tools.
questions: How do I install ansible-dev-tools on RHEL?
Do I need to attach a subscription to install ansible-dev-tools?

answer_card.title: Install ansible-dev-tools on RHEL
answer_card.answer_md:
```
sudo subscription-manager status   # look for Simple Content Access
sudo subscription-manager attach --pool=<sku-pool-id>   # only without SCA
sudo dnf install --enablerepo=ansible-automation-platform-2.6-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms ansible-dev-tools
```

Use the `rhel-8` or `rhel-10` repo name on those releases. Verify with `rpm -qa | grep ansible` and `ansible-creator --help`.
